name: Pseudochimera, Desirette
body:
PSEUDOCHIMERA
CR 2

This tiny creature has the body of a cat, but other two heads-of a snake and a bat- sprout on each side. Bat wings on its back keep it in the air.

XP 600
N Tiny magical beast
Init +2; Senses blindsense 20 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 size)
hp 19 (3d10+3)
Fort +6, Ref +5, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 10 ft. (good)
Melee 2 claws +7 (1d2–2), 2 bites +7 (1d3–2), bite +7 (1d2–2 plus poison)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 6, Dex 15, Con 13, Int 6, Wis 10, Cha 7
Base Atk +3; CMB +3; CMD 10 (14 vs. trip)
Feats Great Fortitude, Weapon Finesse
Skills Climb +8, Fly +8, Perception +8, Stealth +16; Racial Modifiers +2 Climb, +2 Stealth, +4 Perception
Languages Sylvan (can’t speak)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 12; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1 Con damage; cure 1 save.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and hot forests, plains and deserts
Organization solitary, pair, or pack (3–9)
Treasure none

Many different species of pseudochimeras exist, either created intentionally or born by chance from animals living in pools of ancient wild magic. Desirettes are among the most common, but not at all the only ones to live near humans or other sentient races.

More intelligent and friendly than larger chimeras, desirettes have a very feline behavior, and often can be found on the fringe of settlements as pests, begging for food. However, both city dwellers and peasants can find them useful to rid an area from vermin. Other times a pack of pseudochimeras will claim some ancient ruin as their territory, driving away other cats or bats. They fly or hunt on the ground at dusk, catching vermin and little rodents, and attack larger species only out of fear or for self-defense.

Desirettes prefer raw meat, but consider insects and fruit as a treat. They reproduce by laying 3-6 eggs up to three times in a year. Feeding a wild pseudochimera often means being “adopted” by the beast- you won’t be able to get rid of it evermore.

A spellcaster of at least 7th level with the Improved Familiar feat may select a desirette as a familiar.

Other known species of pseudochimeras are cat/fox/pseudodragon, cat/snake/butterfly, cat/pygmy goat/faerie dragon, or cat/snake/flying squirrel. In time, we could have more information on each one of them and more.
